proposed_topic: TOP Heat-pump installers for owner-occupied homes
consumer_problem: Owners must pick an installer for a large, technically demanding investment under changing rules.
target_user: Owners replacing a fossil heating system
target_entity: Service providers and specialist firms in Heat pumps & heating replacement
why_now: Sales went 356,000 (2023) to 193,000 (2024) to 299,000 (2025); heat pumps overtook gas boilers in 2025. Consumers consider independent editorial ranking significantly more trustworthy than sponsored lead-generation marketplaces.

risks_and_uncertainties: Legal & Court Precedent: German judicial rulings challenge commercial quality seals lacking transparent criteria [L028].

historical_learning: Precedent [L028] 'EmpCo / UWG: sustainability labels need certification': Interpretation: Any 'sustainable provider' TOP list/seal (e.g. green craftsmen, sustainable employers) faces higher legal bar; avoid sustainability-claim seals unless certification-based.
next_validation_questions: Can an exhaustive master list be acquired directly from public registers or trade associations?
What objective quality criteria (certifications, inspection reports, customer satisfaction) can be audited at scale?
What is the willingness-to-pay among mid-sized providers for a regional or national quality seal?
